plain_description.what: An engineering check. The tree-building program (a JVM) must read embedding files only through a throwaway working copy that is hash-checked before and after each run. Pinned and source embedding files must never be opened directly.
plain_description.why: The embedder-comparison experiment needs proof that building a tree cannot silently modify the frozen embedding files that other results rely on.
plain_description.information: Success means the embedder-comparison builds can be trusted not to corrupt pinned data. A failure would block those builds. Result: done. The route held: no protected file changed in the trial run or in any of the embedder-comparison builds. Engineering only, no science claim.
